task.title: Prove deployed Loops 5 through 7 with real Agora, policy, Research, and Consultation owners

scope.owned_layer: Current-dev deployed human-learning proof and its bounded evidence
not_changing: Agora, Policy Learning, Research, Consultation, OpenClaw, or Governance product ownership
Live broker, capital, or production authority
The manual-only scanner endpoint before a separate post-proof disposition

single_current_dev_chain.proof_contract: One run must correlate Agora evidence_id, DatasetVersion, durable handoff_id, processed candidate_id, Research task/run, Consultation request/memo, and Governance handoff_id from deployed HTTP readbacks.

no_local_or_fake_authority.proof_contract: The AST guard rejects TestClient, mocks, fake provider, local Consultation executor/store/provider imports, local Policy-to-Research client imports, and direct Agora drainer imports/calls.

restart_replay.proof_contract: The deployed policy scheduler is restarted twice and consultation-svc once; the HTTP-visible durable records remain singular and identity-stable.

automatic_policy_discovery.proof_contract: The harness only creates the durable Agora handoff then restarts/polls policy-learning-shadow-eval-scheduler; it neither imports nor calls shadow-eval-tick or a direct drainer. The candidate must report dataset_source=agora_dataset_version_handoff.

retained_owners: services/policy-learning/scheduler_worker.py durable Agora intake and leased candidate processing
code_disposition.manual_only_legacy_path: services/policy-learning/main.py /api/policy-learning/shadow-eval-tick remains outside the automatic scheduler path; no removal is claimed by this task.

deployment.target: current dev Compose and paper environment
deployment.admission_rule: Do not claim deployed proof or request approval until a committed bounded run report records status=passed against the exact review head.

execution_access.current_dev_compose: The deployed pantheon Compose project exposed healthy operator-bff, policy-learning-svc, policy-learning-shadow-eval-scheduler, research-orchestrator-svc, consultation-svc, openclaw-gateway-adapter, and governance owners.
execution_access.strict_user_boundary: The configured server-bound dev-login identities were exchanged without recording bearer values. The operator identities allow tenant-dev and pantheon-dev; the remaining identities allow tenant-dev only. A real interaction-evidence POST with the operator JWT returned 201.
execution_access.durable_service_boundary: operator-bff reports AGORA_HANDOFF_SERVICE_TENANTS=pantheon-local and policy-learning-shadow-eval-scheduler reports POLICY_LEARNING_AGORA_TENANT_ID=pantheon-local. The test service actor is configured correctly, but every JWT-authorized tenant received 403 tenant-outside-authority from GET /internal/agora/dataset-handoffs.
execution_access.restart_safety: The suite was stopped at the failing durable handoff readback. policy-learning-shadow-eval-scheduler and consultation-svc restart counts remained zero for these attempts.
execution_access.required_handoff: A dev deployment owner must align the Agora service tenant allowlist and policy scheduler tenant with an authorized strict-auth tenant, redeploy the affected owners, then rerun and commit a passed deployed-run.json. No fake provider, direct store access, or local in-process substitute is acceptable.

completed.result: 1 passed, 4 skipped (the four owner-touching cases are opt-in without PANTHEON_L12_HUMAN_LEARNING_E2E=1)

required_before_review: PANTHEON_L12_HUMAN_LEARNING_E2E=1 deployed suite against current dev Compose
Commit deployed-run.json and replace deployment.status with the exact current-dev evidence
Verify restart/replay, provider, and Governance readbacks in that report

required_focus: The exact same candidate flows from durable Agora handoff through Research; no synthetic candidate is introduced.
The test invokes only deployed HTTP boundaries and Compose-owned worker restarts.
The committed run report proves a real OpenClaw contribution and acknowledged Governance handoff without duplicate replay.
